files.notes: User-facing Update firmware file. Read-only UF2 inspection found a valid UF2 image with one app segment at 0x10000000..0x1005df00 and 384768 payload bytes.
User-facing Fresh Install / Clean firmware file. Read-only UF2 inspection found the same app segment as the Update file plus a 524288-byte all-zero high-flash segment at 0x1017f000..0x101ff000.

user_provided_update_procedure:
“Download the latest Firmware below, there are two options.
- Update: Keep all controller profiles as is.
- Fresh Install: Wipes all profiles and restores the factory default profiles.
Connect your Glyph to a computer while holding the illuminated Menu button.
The Glyph will enter programming mode, and appear as a USB drive named RPI-RP2.
Drag and drop the downloaded .uf2 firmware file onto the RPI-RP2 drive.
The USB drive will disconnect, closing the window and the Glyph will connect to the computer as a controller.”
caveats: The update procedure text is user-provided official webpage text and is not independently repo-verified in this branch.
UF2 file structure, sizes, ranges, and hashes are exact for the stored files.
Profile/config wipe interpretation is inferred from the user-facing Fresh Install behavior, the all-zero high-flash segment, and repo build configuration.
Storing these UF2 files does not authorize flashing hardware or copying files to RPI-RP2.
Custom firmware must not be described as safe to flash until artifact format, write ranges, recovery path, and rollback procedure are verified.
